cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

mechanism: A corrects wedding catering attribution as though editing a professional programme, using increasingly precise naming requirements to obtain personal recognition.
confusable: Generic hurt feelings lack the patient editorial corrections from service category to named professional.
comparison: Bridge alternative contests who did structural work; wedding alternative corrects an announcement that credits the food instead of its maker.
seedUse: Buffet seed has a strong person-versus-object correction; remove generic expertise wrapper and preserve surname precision as the result of B offered announcement.
